title: To the Trumps, it’s a tower. To Georgia’s oligarchs, it’s a stamp of approval
text:
In an interview The Real Deal published on Sept. 16, Eric Trump said Trump Tower Tbilisi has “nothing to do with the influence of a government.” Nor, he added, with any influence of his father’s.

The same week, he gave a very different interview, to a very different audience.
